editorialNotes: Current rules and the proposed story remain separate views.
Use the four maintained chapter sections in STORY.md as written; selectors do not introduce a competing plot.
Reward examples are arithmetic samples at the stated level, not a simulated route or a claim-time level prediction.
Recipe diagrams distinguish Magic Mirror material purchases from workbench crafting.
Station and character visuals need current model renders; old outdoor stall previews must not represent the cabin services.

diagramNotes.milestones: Solid sequence means explicit reward claims advance the active story. It is not a prerequisite graph for every free-play activity.
diagramNotes.crop-unlocks: Level gates are current crop rules. Reaching a level does not plant or harvest a crop automatically.
diagramNotes.material-recipe: The leather outfit is a Magic Mirror purchase that also spends materials, not an early workbench recipe.
diagramNotes.stat-wishes: Permanent wishes are the step-six upgrade. Gear bench levels, bed upgrades and chance-based forging are separate systems.
